tracks.title: NV01 • RV Primer 12→7.83 Hz
tracks.description: Alpha→theta ramp landing at 7.83 Hz with pink-noise bed, Schumann AM cue, and HRV-paced envelope.

tracks.title: NV02 • Schumann Hold 7.83 Hz
tracks.description: Constant 7.83 Hz with gentle pink-noise AM at 7.83 Hz and slow-breath coupling.

tracks.title: NV03 • Gate 8→4 Hz
tracks.description: Theta deepening gate with pink-noise bed and 6 Hz AM assist; breath pacing embedded.

tracks.title: NV04 • Theta Stabilizer 6 Hz
tracks.description: Fixed 6 Hz with pink-noise AM for sustained imagery and calm focus.

tracks.title: NV05 • CFC: Theta 6 + Gamma 40
tracks.description: 6 Hz binaural core with 40 Hz modulation on the bed for theta–gamma cross-frequency flavor.

tracks.title: NV06 • Breath-Sync 10→6 Hz
tracks.description: Alpha→theta ramp coupled to 0.1 Hz breath envelope to lock parasympathetic rhythm.

tracks.title: NV07 • Dual-Beat 6 & 12 Hz
tracks.description: Primary 6 Hz with layered 12 Hz pair for alert-yet-internalized attention.

tracks.title: NV08 • Micro-ITD Drift 6 Hz
tracks.description: 6 Hz with ultra-slow interaural phase drift on R channel for subtle lateral spaciousness.

tracks.title: NV09 • Spindle Bridge 13 Hz (bed)
tracks.description: 6 Hz core with 13 Hz AM on noise bed to nod at spindle dynamics without harsh clicks.

tracks.title: NV10 • Gamma-ASSR 8 Hz + 40 AM
tracks.description: 8 Hz beat with 40 Hz tremolo on carriers for an ASSR-friendly hybrid.

tracks.title: NV11 • Delta Gate 4→3 Hz
tracks.description: Theta→delta drift for heavy drop; gentle pink bed only.

tracks.title: NV12 • Anchor Return 8→12 Hz
tracks.description: Re-entry ramp to crisp alpha for clean handoff back to waking.

tracks.title: NV13 • Schumann Steps 7.6→8.06 Hz
tracks.description: Micro-dither around 7.83 Hz with matching AM on the bed for gentle locking.

tracks.title: NV14 • Stochastic Dither 6 Hz
tracks.description: 6 Hz core with ultra-low white-noise layer for stochastic micro-variation.

tracks.title: NV15 • Hemi-Alternator 6 Hz (swap/10s)
tracks.description: 6 Hz with alternating ear dominance every 10 s to refresh lateral attention.
